info.title: AlpenFlight API
info.description: Glider club operations platform. Source of truth for the SPA-generated TS client.

tags.name: Persons
tags.description: Person CRUD (cross-tenant root with tenant-scoped PersonClub child).

tags.name: Planning days

tags.name: DeliveryCreationTests

tags.name: DiscoveryFlightDays

get.summary: List flights (keyset-cursor paginated). When `personId` is supplied (prefixed `pn-<uuid>` per ADR 0019), rows are filtered to flights with a non-deleted FlightCrew row for that person, and the sort order is the AC-defined `flight_date DESC, start_date_time DESC NULLS LAST, created_on DESC` (the third key tie-breaks via UUIDv7 id, which is monotonic-in-creation-time).

post.summary: Create a flight

Paged flight report (legacy PageableSearchFilter shape). Body carries optional sorting (`FlightDuration: asc|desc`) + a flight-report search filter. pageStart is a 0-based row offset; pageSize defaults to 100, capped at 500.

200.description: One page of report rows + total-row count + summaries.

post.summary: Synchronous Excel (.xlsx) export of the flight report. Same body as the page endpoint; streams an attachment in the exact legacy 30-column layout. pageStart is a 0-based row offset; pageSize defaults to 100, capped at 500.

UserUpdateRequest.description: Payload to update a user — mutable fields only. Username / club / keycloakSub are identity-binding and not editable.

UserResponse.description: User detail projection — fields from the local row + live KC role mappings.

PlanningDayUpdateRequest.description: Payload to update a planning day.

LicenceFlags.description: Person-level licence flags + expiry dates. Nullable on Create/Update — omit to keep current values.

PersonUpdateRequest.description: Payload to update Person identity + contact + licences. PersonClub mutations go through /api/v1/persons/{id}/clubs/current.

PersonClubResponse.description: Caller-visible PersonClub row (the caller's tenant only, per Hibernate's @TenantId filter).

PersonResponse.description: Person detail projection — Person identity / contact / licences + caller-visible memberships.

inOtherClubsCount.description: Opaque count of memberships in clubs the caller cannot see. 0 for sysadmin cross-cutting reads.

PersonClubRequest.description: Per-club membership shape. Used as nested in the create request and as request body for join/update sub-resources.

InOutboundPointRequest.description: Payload to create / replace an InOutboundPoint under a Location.

LocationUpdateRequest.description: Payload to update a Location. Replaces the full IOP list (orphan-removal cleans up).

InOutboundPointResponse.description: InOutboundPoint projection — child of a Location.

LocationDetail.description: Location detail projection — full payload + nested IOPs.

FlightCrewItem.description: Single crew row under a Flight.

FlightUpdateRequest.description: Payload to update a Flight. The discriminator (flightAircraftType) is immutable and absent here; aircraftId is mutable at S-058 scope (state-machine gating against booked/invoiced flights is S-059). Tow-link semantics: `towFlightId` value → link; `unlinkTowFlight: true` → explicit unlink; both absent → preserve the existing link (S-063 partial-PUT fix).

FlightDetail.description: Flight detail projection — full payload + crew.

FlightTypeUpdateRequest.description: Payload to update a FlightType. operating_club_id is not settable here (A04 defense).

EmailTemplateSaveRequest.description: Customization payload: upserts the caller's override for the path key+locale.

EmailTemplateListItem.description: One entry of the union read: a file default or the club override that wins over it.

DeliveryCreationTestWriteRequest.description: Create/update payload for a DeliveryCreationTest in the caller's tenant.

expectedDelivery.description: Captured dry-run output to persist as the expected set (absent = leave unchanged).

expectedMatchedFilterIds.description: Matched AccountingRuleFilter ids from the captured dry-run (absent = empty).

active.description: Harness active (absent = true, the legacy default).

mustNotCreateDeliveryForFlight.description: Assert the flight produces NO delivery (absent = false).

ignoreRecipientName.description: Ignore recipient-name mismatch in the diff (absent = false).

ignoreRecipientAddress.description: Ignore recipient-address mismatch in the diff (absent = false).

ignoreRecipientPersonId.description: Ignore recipient-person-id mismatch in the diff (absent = false).

ignoreRecipientClubMemberNumber.description: Ignore recipient-club-member-number mismatch in the diff (absent = false).

ignoreDeliveryInformation.description: Ignore delivery-information mismatch in the diff (absent = false).

ignoreAdditionalInformation.description: Ignore additional-information mismatch in the diff (absent = false).

ignoreItemPositioning.description: Ignore item-positioning mismatch in the diff (absent = false).

ignoreItemText.description: Ignore item-text mismatch in the diff (absent = false).

ignoreItemAdditionalInformation.description: Ignore item-additional-information mismatch in the diff (absent = false).

DeliveryCreationTestDetail.description: DeliveryCreationTest detail projection — full round-trip payload.

lastTestResultMessage.description: Last run's diff message (null = never run).

lastTestRunOn.description: When the harness was last run (null = never run).

lastTestCreatedDelivery.description: The engine output captured by the last run (null = never run).

ClubUpdateRequest.description: Payload to update a club. `clubKey` is immutable post-create.

discoveryFlightOperatorEmail.description: Organiser-notification recipients, separated by comma, semicolon or whitespace. Null or blank means the club receives no organiser mail, which is a valid state — the registration still succeeds. Discovery-flight registrations.

scenicFlightOperatorEmail.description: Organiser-notification recipients, separated by comma, semicolon or whitespace. Null or blank means the club receives no organiser mail, which is a valid state — the registration still succeeds. Scenic-flight registrations.

discoveryFlightTypeId.description: Flight type stamped on the reservation a discovery-flight registration books; null books the reservation without one.

homebaseId.description: The club's home airfield — must be one of the club's OWN Locations. Null clears it, which is a valid state: a club without a homebase still accepts discovery-flight registrations, only the reservation is skipped. The update is full-replace, so an omitted key clears the homebase too.

ClubResponse.description: Club projection returned to API consumers.

discoveryFlightOperatorEmail.description: Organiser-notification recipients, separated by comma, semicolon or whitespace. Null or blank means the club receives no organiser mail, which is a valid state — the registration still succeeds. Discovery-flight registrations.

scenicFlightOperatorEmail.description: Organiser-notification recipients, separated by comma, semicolon or whitespace. Null or blank means the club receives no organiser mail, which is a valid state — the registration still succeeds. Scenic-flight registrations.

discoveryFlightTypeId.description: Flight type stamped on the reservation a discovery-flight registration books; null books the reservation without one.

homebaseId.description: The club's home airfield — must be one of the club's OWN Locations. Null clears it, which is a valid state: a club without a homebase still accepts discovery-flight registrations, only the reservation is skipped. The update is full-replace, so an omitted key clears the homebase too.

joinCode.description: Club join code — present only for a CLUB_ADMINISTRATOR; null otherwise.

ArticleUpdateRequest.description: Payload to update an Article. operating_club_id is not settable here (A04 defense).

AircraftUpdateRequest.description: Payload to update an Aircraft. Ownership fields are not settable here — use the transfer-ownership endpoint (A04 defense).

AircraftDetail.description: Aircraft detail projection — full payload including current state + latest counter.

AircraftOperatingCounterResponse.description: Single operating-counter entry under an Aircraft.

AircraftStateHistoryEntryResponse.description: Single state-history entry under an Aircraft.

AircraftReservationUpdateRequest.description: Payload to update an aircraft reservation.

AccountingRuleFilterWriteRequest.description: Create/update payload for an AccountingRuleFilter in the caller's tenant.

active.description: Filter active (absent = true, the legacy default).

stopRuleEngineWhenApplied.description: Stop the rule engine when this rule applies (absent = false).

chargedToClubInternal.description: Charge the recipient to the club internally (absent = false; sent only for recipient filters).

AccountingRuleFilterDetail.description: AccountingRuleFilter detail projection — full round-trip payload.

UserInviteRequest.description: Payload to invite a new user. Backend creates the Keycloak user, then inserts the FLS row in the same transaction; on DB failure the KC user is compensated-deleted.

DiscoveryFlightRegistrationRequest.description: A discovery-flight submission: who registers, and for which published day.

PlanningDayCreateRequest.description: Payload to create a planning day.

PlanningDayValidateRequest.description: Candidate (date, location) to pre-check for a duplicate planning day (non-mutating).

excludePlanningDayId.description: On an edit, the planning day's own id — excluded from the uniqueness probe so it does not self-conflict. Absent on a create check.

PlanningDayValidationResult.description: Field-level validation outcome for an inline pre-check (200; valid flag + offending field).

PlanningDayPageRequest.description: Legacy PageableSearchFilter-shaped paged-list request (Day.From filter + sorting).

sorting.description: Column→direction map; only `planningDate: asc|desc` honoured (default asc).

PlanningDaySearchFilter.description: Basic paged-list filter — the legacy Day.From lower-bound date (J-6 scope).

PlanningDayPage.description: Paged planning-day list envelope (SPA-compat page shape).

PlanningDayRuleRequest.description: Bulk weekday-expansion rule (inclusive range × selected weekdays at a location).

PersonCreateRequest.description: Payload to create a new Person. The optional initialClubMembership creates the first PersonClub in the caller's tenant in the same transaction.

PersonLookupRequest.description: Exact-match-only lookup payload. Either provide email, OR provide the full identity triple (firstname + lastname + birthday). Partial triples are rejected.

PersonLookupMatch.description: Slim per-match shape. No address, no licence flags — just enough to identify the person before attaching.

alreadyInThisClub.description: True iff this Person already has an alive PersonClub in the caller's tenant.

PersonLookupResult.description: Cap at 5; exact-match never returns more.

LocationCreateRequest.description: Payload to create a Location. ICAO code is optional but uppercase-regex bound when present.

SubmitJoinRequest.description: A pilot's request to join a club, keyed by the club's join code.

note.description: Optional note to the admin (≤500 chars).

DenyJoinRequest.description: A CLUB_ADMINISTRATOR's denial of a join request.

reason.description: Optional reason shown to the denied pilot (≤500 chars).

ApproveJoinRequest.description: A CLUB_ADMINISTRATOR's approval of a join request.

roles.description: Realm roles to grant the new member.

personId.description: Optional existing Person to link (must be in the admin's club).

FlightCreateRequest.description: Payload to create a Flight. State-machine columns are server-set; ownership tenant rides from the JWT (A04 defense).

FlightReportPageRequest.description: Legacy PageableSearchFilter-shaped flight-report request (sorting + filter criteria).

sorting.description: Column→direction map; only `FlightDuration: asc|desc` is honoured.

FlightReportSearchFilter.description: Flight-report filter criteria (legacy FlightReportFilterCriteria; type flags default on/on/off).

FlightReportDataRecord.description: One flight-report data row (one row per flight).

FlightReportResult.description: Paged flight-report result: data rows + total-row count + (T-04) summaries.

FlightReportSummary.description: Flight-report summary row (one crew-function/flight-type group, plus a Total row).

TowFlightReportDataRecord.description: Nested tow-flight block under an aerotow glider row.

FlightTypeCreateRequest.description: Payload to register a new FlightType in the caller's tenant.

DiscoveryFlightDayCreateRequest.description: Payload to publish a new discovery-flight day for the caller's club.

eventDate.description: Calendar day to offer discovery flights on. Must not be in the past, and must not already be offered.

DiscoveryFlightDayResponse.description: A discovery-flight day the club currently offers.

RunTestResult.description: Run-test result — pass/fail + the field-by-field diff message + the engine output.

DeliveryOverview.description: Delivery list-row projection — tenant-scoped, sorted batch desc / recipient asc.

deliveryNumber.description: Booked delivery number (free-text, null until booked).

recipientName.description: Recipient display name (lastname firstname, or the company name).

processStateId.description: V4 process-state code: 10 Prepared / 20 Booked / 30 Error / 99 Cancelled.

DeliveryPage.description: Paged delivery list envelope (SPA-compat page shape).

DeliveryBookingRequest.description: Book a Prepared delivery as delivered (external finance confirmation).

deliveryNumber.description: Externally-supplied delivery (invoice) number; free-text, no counter.

DeliveryDetail.description: Delivery detail projection — full read-only invoice draft.

deliveryNumber.description: Booked delivery number (free-text, null until booked).

processStateId.description: V4 process-state code: 10 Prepared / 20 Booked / 30 Error / 99 Cancelled.

flight.description: The linked flight (id only; the SPA decorates date/aircraft/pilot). Null on a delivery not linked to a flight.

DeliveryFlightSummary.description: The linked flight (id only; the SPA decorates the rest — no cross-module join).

DeliveryItemView.description: Read-only line item (engine output, never hand-editable).

unitType.description: Frozen unit-type code (legacy UnitType, e.g. Sec/Pcs/Min).

DeliveryRecipientView.description: The nine frozen recipient-snapshot fields (OR Art. 957a; never re-resolved).

ClubCreateRequest.description: Payload to create a new club.

JoinCodeResponse.description: The newly rotated club join code.

ArticleCreateRequest.description: Payload to register a new Article in the caller's tenant.

AircraftCreateRequest.description: Payload to register a new Aircraft. Ownership defaults to the managing club; change via transfer-ownership.

AircraftTransferOwnershipRequest.description: CLUB_ADMINISTRATOR-only payload to transfer ownership metadata. Managing tenant is unchanged.

AircraftStateChangeRequest.description: Payload to record a new state for an Aircraft (closes the previous open period).

AircraftCounterRecordRequest.description: Payload to record a new operating-counter snapshot.

AircraftReservationCreateRequest.description: Payload to create an aircraft reservation.

AircraftReservationValidateRequest.description: Candidate aircraft-slot fields to pre-check for overlap (non-mutating).

excludeReservationId.description: On an edit, the reservation's own id — excluded from the overlap probe so it does not self-conflict. Absent on a create check.

ReservationValidationResult.description: Field-level validation outcome for an inline pre-check (200; valid flag + offending field).

AircraftReservationPageRequest.description: Legacy PageableSearchFilter-shaped paged-list request (sorting + basic filter).

sorting.description: Column→direction map; only `start: asc|desc` is honoured (default asc).

AircraftReservationSearchFilter.description: Basic paged-list filter — date-range narrowing on the reservation start (J-5 scope).

AircraftReservationListItem.description: Aircraft-reservation list row (FK ids + same-module type name; SPA decorates the rest).

AircraftReservationPage.description: Paged aircraft-reservation list envelope (SPA-compat page shape).

MeProfileUpdateRequest.description: Account self-edit payload — caller's own User self-fields only.

notificationEmail.description: Notification email (distinct from the Keycloak login email).

languageId.description: Preferred language id; must resolve to a known language.

id.description: Internal user.id (UUID). Null when the JWT sub matches no active user row.

personId.description: Linked Person id, prefixed external form `pn-<uuid>`. Null when user.person_id is null (sysadmin / unmapped federated user).

clubId.description: Caller's home club, prefixed external form `clb-<uuid>`. Null when no user row matches the JWT sub.

roles.description: AlpenFlight realm roles (no `ROLE_` prefix). Filtered to the canonical role catalog server-side; Keycloak built-ins (`uma_authorization`, `offline_access`, `default-roles-*`) are stripped.

firstName.description: First name. Resolved from the linked Person row when present, otherwise from the JWT `given_name` claim.

lastName.description: Last name. Same resolution as firstName.

email.description: Notification email from the user row, or JWT `email` claim when no user matches.

username.description: Username from the user row, or JWT `preferred_username` claim when no user matches.

friendlyName.description: Account display name (`t_user.friendly_name`). The Account self-edit form's initial value; null when no user row matches the JWT sub.

phoneNumber.description: Contact phone (`t_user.phone_number`). Account self-edit field; nullable.

languageId.description: Preferred-language id (`t_user.language_id`, raw UUID). The Account language-selector's current value; null when no user row matches.

languageCode.description: BCP-47 code of `languageId` (e.g. `de`, `fr`). Lets the SPA flip its active locale on a saved language change without a second round-trip.

homebaseLocationId.description: Caller's club homebase Location id, prefixed external form `loc-<uuid>` (matches `LocationId` / `FlightReportSearchFilter.locationId`, so the SPA passes it straight into a LOCATION canned report). Null when the club has no homebase set or no user row matches the JWT sub.

MePersonUpdateRequest.description: Person-contact self-edit payload — caller's own contact / address fields only.

preferMailToBusinessMail.description: Prefer the business email for club correspondence (absent = false).

MePersonLicencesUpdateRequest.description: Person licence/medical self-edit payload — caller's own pilot/medical fields only.

hasTmgLicence.description: Holds a TMG (touring motor glider) licence (absent = false).

hasGliderTowingStartPermission.description: Has glider aerotow start permission (absent = false).

hasGliderSelfStartPermission.description: Has glider self-launch start permission (absent = false).

hasGliderWinchStartPermission.description: Has glider winch-launch start permission (absent = false).

MePersonLicencesResponse.description: Caller's own Person licence/medical fields (read shape for the Pilot tab).

MeNotificationPrefsUpdateRequest.description: Per-club notification-prefs self-edit payload — caller's own three toggles only.

MeNotificationPrefsResponse.description: Caller's own per-club notification preferences (read shape for the Notifications tab).

FlightProcessStateChangeRequest.description: Request body for `PATCH /api/v1/flights/{id}/process-state`. The transition matrix gates which state changes are legal under the OPERATOR trigger.

FlightProcessStateResponse.description: Response for a successful PATCH on process-state — minimal payload reflecting the persisted change.

roles.description: Roles read live from Keycloak realm-role mappings.

invitePending.description: True iff the KC user has unresolved required-actions (e.g. UPDATE_PASSWORD).

PublicClubResponse.description: The public identity of a club that accepts anonymous registration.

PersonListItem.description: Person listitem projection — one row per (Person, caller-tenant PersonClub) pair.

totalClubs.description: Total active clubs across the whole deployment.

totalUsers.description: Total active users across all clubs.

totalFlights.description: Total non-deleted flights across all clubs.

MePersonResponse.description: Caller's own Person contact / address fields (read shape for the Personal tab).

ClubDashboardResponse.description: Club-admin dashboard tile counts (caller's club only).

todaysFlights.description: Count of the caller club's flights flown today (flight_date = today).

pendingValidation.description: Count of the caller club's flights pending validation (process state NotProcessed or Invalid).

LocationListItem.description: Location listitem projection — sort_indicator + name ordered.

PendingJoinRequestResponse.description: A pending join request as the club admin sees it.

FlightListItem.description: Flight list-row projection — basic CRUD scope; decorations (aircraft immat, pilot name) deferred. Carries `version` so concurrency-aware actions (e.g. DELETE with If-Match) can fire from the list view without a follow-up GET.

FlightListResponse.description: Keyset-cursor list response. Filter via from/to; scroll via nextCursor.

FlightTemplateResponse.description: Editable-surface projection for new-flight and copy-flight templates. Carries no id / version / state-machine / audit metadata. Times + comments + engine counters are cleared on copy-template per legacy `FlightsController.js:232-255`.

FlightLastContextResponse.description: Last-flight context for the (aircraft, date) tuple — seeds the flight-edit form's empty state per the mobile-first amendment (vision §F6 / AC-DIR-1). 404 when no prior flight matches.

FlightTypeListItem.description: FlightType listitem projection — sorted by name.

FlightCrewTypeResponse.description: FlightCrewType listitem projection — drives the flightCrewTypes match-list dropdown on the accounting rule-filter edit form.

DeliveryCreationTestListItem.description: DeliveryCreationTest list-row projection — tenant-scoped, ordered by name.

lastTestRunOn.description: When the harness was last run (null = never run).

ExampleDeliveryResult.description: Dry-run engine output for a flight — no persistence (fills the expected set).

CounterUnitTypeResponse.description: CounterUnitType listitem projection — drives the operating-counter unit dropdowns on the Aircraft form.

MemberStateListItem.description: Tenant-scoped listitem projection for the form picker.

ArticleListItem.description: Article listitem projection — sorted by articleNumber.

AircraftListItem.description: Aircraft listitem projection — sorted by immatriculation.

AircraftStateHistory.description: Paginated list of state-history entries (newest first).

AircraftCounterHistory.description: Paginated list of operating-counter entries (newest first).

AircraftPickerItem.description: Aircraft picker projection — slim shape for FE pickers on Flight / Reservation forms.

nrOfSeats.description: Seat count — drives the conditional Second-Crew requirement on the reservation form (required when nrOfSeats > 1). Nullable: an aircraft may have an unknown seat count.

AircraftTypeResponse.description: AircraftType listitem projection — drives the type-discriminator dropdown + filter slices.

AircraftStateResponse.description: AircraftState listitem projection — drives the airworthiness dropdown.

AircraftReservationTypeListItem.description: Reservation-type listitem for the type dropdown.

instructorRequired.description: Whether picking this type requires a Second-Crew person. AlpenFlight's reservation-type model carries only the single is_instructor_required flag; the legacy ObserverPilotOrInstructorRequired / IsPassengerRequired FlightType-derived flags are NOT modeled here, so this one boolean is the collapsed second-crew-required driver for the type lane (the aircraft NrOfSeats>1 driver rides the picker).

AccountingUnitTypeResponse.description: AccountingUnitType listitem projection — drives the AccountingUnitType picker on the article-target section of the accounting rule-filter edit form.

AccountingRuleFilterListItem.description: AccountingRuleFilter list-row projection — sorted by sort indicator.

AccountingRuleFilterTypeResponse.description: AccountingRuleFilterType listitem projection — drives the accounting rule-filter edit-form type picker. The accounting form keys its conditional-section visibility off legacyId (article-target ∉{5,10}, recipient ==10, aircraft-filter ==30, no-landing-tax ==20), so both id (UUID) and legacyId (int) are exposed.

bearerAuth.description: OIDC bearer token (Keycloak in dev, hosted IdP TBD in prod).
